font_rule.pixel_height: median per-letter 5th--95th ink-row mass extent; prefer alpha epsilon omicron sigma pi nu omega upsilon
font_rule.fallback: all alphabetic spans; if blank, median CTC width / 0.6
font_rule.vertical: entire original line crop, including all available mark zone
font_rule.fused: 8-connected Otsu components >=0.45 font-height; multiple CTC character primary owners by largest horizontal overlap; diagnostic only

reference_boundary: infer_line receives id, crop, recognizer alignment, detector model, R1 model only
